memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “You shall make a parapet for your roof, that you may not bring blood upon your house.”  (Deuteronomy 22:8)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In the Old Testament, God commanded Israel to build walls called parapet around their rooftops. If a man fell from a house with parapet, he bore his own loss. But if someone fell from a house without parapet, God held the owner responsible.

This is a picture of the Church today.
Sound doctrine is the parapet that protects believers from falling into sin and spiritual danger. A church that teaches the true Gospel, strong warnings, holy living, and Christ-centered doctrine provides safety and stability to its people. But a church without teaching, without correction, and without truth will cause many to fall and the shepherd will answer to God.
Do you have strong biblical teaching in your life?
Give thanks to the Lord. If not, pray that God will plant you in a place of truth, holiness, and spiritual strength. In times when people drift toward the world, God calls us to hold fast to sound doctrine as our spiritual handrail.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “The Church is safest when it stands firmly on the solid foundation of Scripture.”  Charles Spurgeon

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, build strong spiritual parapet (handrails) around my life through Your Word. Protect me from falling, strengthen me with truth, and plant me in a place where sound doctrine is taught. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord surround you with strong truth and steady your steps. May His Word be the (parapet) handrail that keeps you safe every day.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: “Knowing Scripture”
recommended_book.author: R. C. Sproul
recommended_book.quote: A reminder that sound doctrine guards the believer like a wall of protection.
